note: Curated from public reporting. Every entry links to its source. This layer is maintained by hand; the live layer on the radar comes from OpenCTI.

incidents.title: Dutch Prosecution Service cuts itself off from the internet
incidents.summary: The Dutch Public Prosecution Service disconnected from the internet for several weeks after an NCSC alert about a potential Citrix NetScaler vulnerability used for remote access. The same window precedes the Dutch Caribbean incidents.

incidents.title: Joint Court of Justice hit across six islands
incidents.summary: The Joint Court of Justice serving the six Dutch Caribbean islands suffered a cyberattack that disrupted email systems and court proceedings.

incidents.title: Ransomware encrypts Curaçao Tax and Customs Administration
incidents.summary: Ransomware hit Curaçao's Tax and Customs Administration. Vehicle-tax processing, phone support and in-person service went down; the public filing portal was deliberately kept online. Recovery took close to two weeks with support from Dutch IT security specialists.

incidents.title: Aruba Parliament email account compromised
incidents.summary: One of the Aruban Parliament's official email accounts was compromised through phishing. Parliament warned the public not to open links or attachments in messages that appeared to come from it.

incidents.title: Parliament expands phishing warning to local organisations
incidents.summary: Follow-up warnings describe a phishing email circulating locally, designed to steal sensitive information, and note that local organisations were affected alongside Parliament.

incidents.title: National phishing warning issued by KPA and VDA
incidents.summary: Aruba's police corps (KPA) and security service (VDA) issued a national warning about a persistent phishing wave. Lures impersonated Adobe, DocuSign and SharePoint; messages arrived from known contacts and explicitly aimed to bypass Microsoft Authenticator. The advice: reset passwords, end all sessions, avoid Outlook web, and report to KPA.
